newsitem.title: SYRIA: SOCCER-IRAN BEAT MALDIVES 17-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IRAN BEAT MALDIVES 17-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Iran beat Maldives by a record score of 17-0 (halftime 6-0) in a World Cup soccer Asian zone group 2 qualifying match on Monday.
Scorers: Karim Bakeri 5, Humaid Astyli 4, Ali Dae 3, Khodad Azizi 2, Reza Shah Rodi, Mehrzad Menavenisheen, Mahdi Kia.
The previous highest World Cup score was 13-0 when New Zealand beat Fiji in 1981.
Monday's other group two fixture in Damscus between Syria and Kyrgyzstan did not take place after Kyrgyzstan failed to arrive.
